title: Tile spec
description: One row of the static industry-tile table. 31 rows across six industries; a player mat holds 45 tiles in total.

level.description: Tile level. Coal/iron/brewery/cotton go to 4, pottery to 5, manufacturer to 8.

count.description: Copies of this row on a player mat.

cost.description: Money to build, before sourcing coal and iron. Pottery L2 and L4 cost 0.

coal.description: Coal cubes consumed to build. Sourced from the nearest connected mine before the market is priced.

iron.description: Iron cubes consumed to build. Sourced from any unflipped works, at any distance, before the market.

beers-to-sell.description: Barrels needed to flip this tile by selling. null = never sold (coal, iron, brewery); 0 = sellable for free (Manufacturer L3 and L7).

vp.description: Victory points scored at end of era, only once the tile is flipped.

income.description: Income SPACES gained on flip. Spaces, not levels: the track is non-linear.

link-vp.description: Connection icon. Scored for adjacent links whether or not the tile is flipped.

can-develop.description: false is the lightbulb: the tile cannot be removed by a Develop action. Pottery L1 and L3 only.

produces.description: Cubes placed on the tile when built. Always 0 for breweries: their real barrel count is beerProduced(era), 1 in canal and 2 in rail.
